sanskrit_verse:
mahāparādhe nirdharme kṛtaghne klībakutsite
nāstikavrātyadāseṣu kośapānaṃ vivarjayet
transliteration:
mahāparādhe nirdharme kṛtaghne klībakutsite
nāstikavrātyadāseṣu kośapānaṃ vivarjayet
sph_interpretive_translation: In cases of grave transgression against Dharma, betrayal of trust, degradation of sacred duty, and among those who are faithless, renegade, or enslaved by vice—financial penalty must be withheld.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from alignment with Sanatana Dharma, not institutional position
Causation is traced through conscious deviation from svadharma
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by spiritual maturity and self-governance
Restoration logic requires withdrawal of support from destructive patterns
Consciousness alignment demands reallocation of resources toward dharmic ends
executable_legal_axioms: IF actor.commit.level = mahāparādha AND dharma.alignment.status = nirdharma THEN resource.withdrawal = TRUE
IF actor.trust.betrayed = TRUE AND actor.sacred.duty.degraded = TRUE THEN financial.penalty.eligibility = FALSE
IF actor.faith.status = nāstika OR actor.dharma.compliance = vrātya THEN economic.support.vector = null
supreme_court_application: At the highest judicial level, this verse establishes that individuals guilty of severe dharmic violations or systemic betrayal are categorically disqualified from receiving state-funded restitution. The court must assess not just action but ontological alignment with Sanatana principles when determining eligibility for monetary relief.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that misaligned actions stem from inner disorder; thus, withholding fiscal reinforcement breaks the cycle without inflicting harm. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows how continued indulgence perpetuates further imbalance. Responsibility lies in redirecting energy toward purification, not imposing punitive suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Redirect all involved funds into Consciousness Restoration Centers
Assign Vedic Completion Rituals based on degree of deviation
Activate Community Witness Protocols to restore integrity field
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Dharma stands restored. There is no punishment—only precise alignment with the eternal rhythm of consciousness. The law executes itself when rooted in pure awareness.
